scope: Bounded self-authored C jump-map primitives derived from static native instruction evidence, with independent analytical validation. No target execution or runtime-conformance claim.

api.rb_native_jump_point: uint32 period_bits; double seconds; double ticks
api.rb_native_map_validate: Canonical 1/2-point state check; exact binary64 anchor recurrence, not a tolerance or rewrite.
api.rb_native_map_seconds: Detached tick-to-second arithmetic; exact knot chooses new point; separate SUB/MUL/DIV/ADD.
api.rb_native_map_ticks: Detached second-to-tick arithmetic; exact knot chooses preceding point; positive path uses two explicit FMA sites then floor/div1000; zero path bypasses quantizer.

domain.period: Direct positive normal binary32 bits; no reconstructed reciprocal BPM. Display BPM domain is caller responsibility.
domain.anchors: First seconds and ticks must be positive zero; second finite normal positive and strictly increasing; seconds <=3e9 and ticks <=480e9.
domain.query: Finite normal nonnegative or signed zero, within coordinate bounds; intermediate underflow/overflow and out-of-domain results reject.
domain.errors: Return INVALID=1, FP_ENVIRONMENT=2, UNREPRESENTABLE=3; conversion output unchanged on error.
domain.sign_zero: Forward seconds=-0 retains tick=-0 via explicit zero path; inverse tick=-0 yields seconds=+0 through final +0 anchor addition.

canonicality: Conversions deliberately preserve detached serialized anchors and do not silently canonicalize. Importer must additionally call rb_native_map_validate and prove role/lifecycle/source state; this C API alone does not establish active native list/cache identity.
emitted_code: Optimized ARM64 public forward body contains exactly two FMADD instructions plus FRINTM. Inverse and canonical validation retain separate SUB/MUL/DIV/ADD. Fixed functions retain their Float32 FDIV and ordered Float64 operations. Exact symbol-relative inventories retained in comparison record.
oracle_limits: The three raw-FMA distinctions disappear after final quantization; no final-output distinction is claimed for those three.
The fused quantizer discriminator outside the public tick bound exercises a test-only internal wrapper, absent from app; it does not expand API bounds.
Synthetic unequal-anchor vectors validate detached arithmetic and deliberately fail canonical import validation.
fixed_preservation: Original complete C prefix has unchanged SHA256; all36 retained fixed-clock oracle vectors still bit-exact in optimized build.
swift_tests: Three targeted NativeMapKernelTests methods authored; not run in this step because root coordinates SwiftPM suite.
review: Independent source review requested from cubase_evidence; pending at record time.
